subject: radial_class
operational_definition: r
required_preservation: fiber_class; spin horizon; spin prefix; anchor factor; composite_compat_class
on_failure: reject comparison if unequal and no radial_lift

subject: fiber_class
operational_definition: phi
required_preservation: radial_class; spin horizon; anchor factor; composite_compat_class
on_failure: reject comparison if unequal and no fiber_refinement_lift

subject: spin_class
operational_definition: spin_H or explicit spin_h
required_preservation: radial_class; fiber_class; compatibility class; spin prefix
on_failure: raise INCOMPLETE_STATE_TYPING if spin_H/spin_h absent where needed

subject: composite_compat_class
operational_definition: ordered shared-prime masks over {2,3,5} for (query,binding)
required_preservation: prime-support mask; anchor factor; radial_class; fiber_class; spin_class
on_failure: reject comparison if unequal and no compatibility_normalization_lift

subject: shape_class
operational_definition: repeated_prime or mixed_semiprime from factor pair
on_failure: raise TYPE_CONFUSION if used as fiber_class

subject: direct_comparison
operational_definition: same radial_class; same fiber_class; same spin horizon; same spin_class; same composite_compat_class

subject: radial_cross_class
operational_definition: states differ in r
required_preservation: fiber_class; spin prefix; anchor factor; composite_compat_class

subject: fiber_cross_class
operational_definition: states differ in phi
required_preservation: radial_class; anchor factor; composite_compat_class; spin horizon

subject: spin_cross_class
operational_definition: states differ in spin_H or spin_h
required_preservation: radial_class; fiber_class; compatibility class; spin prefix

subject: compat_cross_class
operational_definition: states differ in composite_compat_class
required_preservation: prime-support mask; anchor factor; radial_class; fiber_class; spin_class

subject: within_class_transport
operational_definition: ordinary move preserving all four primary identities
required_preservation: anchor factor retained; next composite shares anchor; composite_compat_class preserved; spin horizon preserved; spin_class preserved

subject: radial_lift_transport
operational_definition: named move changing r only through explicit lift
required_preservation: anchor factor; fiber_class; composite_compat_class; transported spin word

subject: fiber_refinement_transport
operational_definition: named move changing phi only through explicit refinement map
required_preservation: r; anchor factor; composite_compat_class; transported spin word

subject: spin_lift_transport
operational_definition: named move changing spin only through admissibility-word update law

subject: forbidden_transport
operational_definition: ordinary candidate changes radial or fiber or spin or compatibility class without named lift

subject: reject_candidate
operational_definition: candidate violates direct comparison rule for ordinary transport

subject: incompatibility_state
operational_definition: no legal candidate remains or required class variable/lift is missing

subject: refuse_fallback
operational_definition: all remaining options are illegal or only incompatible candidates exist

subject: refuse_scoring
operational_definition: candidate/source pair not directly comparable and not lifted

subject: pre_generation
operational_definition: state must expose (radial_class,fiber_class,spin_identity,composite_compat_class)

subject: pre_scoring
operational_definition: every candidate must declare transport type: within_class or named lift

subject: legality_filter
operational_definition: ordinary candidates must match source on radial,fiber,spin,compatibility

subject: pool_separation
operational_definition: within-class candidates and lift candidates may not share one scoring pool
on_failure: stop and choose transport family first

subject: pre_update
operational_definition: selected candidate must satisfy invariants for declared transport type

subject: post_update
operational_definition: recomputed class tuple must match declared transport relation

subject: prior_branch_violation
operational_definition: r5-r7 allowed scoring across incompatible class boundaries without explicit lifts
required_preservation: single most important invariant: no shared scoring pool across class boundaries without lawful lift
on_failure: framework should have hard-stopped those branches

subject: single_next_step
operational_definition: implement one legality gate module computing native class tuples and blocking illegal scoring
required_preservation: enforce direct comparison or named lift before scoring
on_failure: do this before any further rebuild or experiment
